products.description:
About this product


When you need a compact home office printer that can handle all your work needs, the Canon PIXMA TR8620a has you covered. With front and rear paper feeding, an individual ink system, 4.3" LCD touch screen, and impressive wired and wireless connectivity options, you'll be able to do it all. The PIXMA TR8620a can easily transition from scanning a multipage contract with the built-in auto document feeder to printing double-sided homework assignments from online classrooms systems, or a family photo wirelessly from your smartphone. Whether it's printing documents and reports, or faxing and scanning, the PIXMA TR8620a is the ultimate compact home office printer that's big on performance and productivity.


  • All-in-one printer gives you printing, copying, and scanning capability


  • Inkjet printer has a resolution quality that goes up to 4800 x 1200 dpi for excellent readability


  • Print speed: 15 ppm in black/white and 10 ppm in color


  • 1 x USB 2.0, 1 x LAN, 1 x memory card slot, and Wi-Fi connectivity help enhance productivity


  • Dimensions: 7.5"H x 17.3"W x 13.8"D


  • Types of media supported include: semigloss photo paper, high-resolution paper, recycled paper, photo paper, labels, luster paper, plain paper, magnetic photo paper, cards, matte photo paper; total paper input capacity: 200 sheets


  • Fax memory accommodates up to 250 pages for snag-free operation


  • Helps save paper and create two-sided documents with automatic duplex printing and an auto feeder with a 20-sheet capacity


  • Easily manage tasks with the 4.3" touch screen


  • 1200 x 2400 dpi optical resolution, 8-bit color depth, 8-bit grayscale depth for good-quality printed text and images


  • Meets or exceeds the ENERGY STAR standard


  • Includes: TR8620 all-in-one printer, set of standard ink tanks (PGBK, BK, C, M, Y, PB), RJ11 telephone/modem cords, power cord


  • 1-year manufacturer limited warranty

Ideal for business owners and office managers who print black-and-white documents regularly and need proven print solutions to stay productive.

This printer is intended to work only with cartridges that have a new or reused HP chip, and it uses dynamic security measures to block cartridges using a non-HP chip. Periodic firmware updates will maintain the effectiveness of these measures and block cartridges that previously worked. A reused HP chip enables the use of reused, remanufactured, and refilled cartridges.

Built for fast and reliable printing

Deliver multipage documents quickly with fast two-sided printing. Rely on consistent, high-quality prints page after page from an industry leader. Stay connected with reliable dual-band Wi-Fi that automatically reconnects to keep you online. Easily share resources and access printing with wireless and Ethernet networking.

Award-winning design to fit your workspace

Small in size but big in performance, this printer combines advanced power with an award-winning design. Save space and reduce clutter with a modern, sleek look that fits easily into your workspace. Get projects done faster with this high-performance compact LaserJet.

Easy to set up, easy to use

Get started quickly with easy setup guidance from the HP app and get back to business faster. Use time-saving shortcuts and easily access and print documents and images from your mobile devices. Connect your printer to your computer with the built-in USB port. Manage tasks effortlessly with smart-guided buttons and lighting that appear only when needed.

Energy efficient design

Optimize energy usage with HP Auto-On/Auto-Off technology. Easily recycle used Original HP Toner Cartridges for free through the HP Planet Partners program. This HP LaserJet meets ecolabel requirements, including ENERGY STAR and Blue Angel.
